User-agent: *
Allow: /

# The host on the Sitemap line below is written by the build, not by whoever edits this
# file: `npm run mirror` replaces that line with the same origin it used for every page's
# canonical URL and every <loc> in sitemap.xml. It has to match, because a robots file
# naming another domain is read as a foreign sitemap and discarded, and the site loses
# its index quietly - no page on it looks wrong.
#
# So the value below is only a placeholder for a build that never ran. To serve the site
# from somewhere else, pass the flag; do not edit this line, or the next build overwrites
# it and the two disagree until someone notices:
#
#   npm run mirror --site-origin https://www.tftstar.com
#
Sitemap: https://www.tftstar.com/sitemap.xml
